nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, $H$ a simple graph, $Q_n$ the $n$-dimensional hypercube, and $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ the hypercube Turán number. If $Q_n$ has at least one subgraph (not necessarily spanning) that contains no copy of $H$, then some subgraph $S$ of $Q_n$ contains no copy of $H$ and has exactly $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ edges.
nodes.title: Attainment of the hypercube Turán number

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and all vertices $x, y$ of the $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$ (functions from $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ to the Booleans), $x$ and $y$ are adjacent in $Q_n$ if and only if there is exactly one coordinate $i$ with $x_i \ne y_i$.
nodes.title: Adjacency in the hypercube

nodes.summary: In the $1$-dimensional hypercube $Q_1$, the constant vertex $\mathrm{true}$ and the constant vertex $\mathrm{false}$ are adjacent.
nodes.title: An edge of the one-dimensional hypercube

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, every subgraph of the $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$ has at most as many edges as $Q_n$.
nodes.title: Subgraphs of the hypercube have at most as many edges

nodes.summary: The edge set of the $0$-dimensional hypercube $Q_0$ is empty.
nodes.title: The zero-dimensional hypercube has no edges

nodes.summary: For all vertices $x, y$ of the $0$-dimensional hypercube $Q_0$, $x$ and $y$ are not adjacent in $Q_0$.
nodes.title: No two vertices of the zero-dimensional hypercube are adjacent

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$ is the simple graph whose vertices are the functions from $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ to the Booleans $\{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$, with an edge between two vertices exactly when they differ in exactly one coordinate.
nodes.title: Hypercube graph

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube, let $C_4$ be the cycle on four vertices, and let $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, C_4)$ be the largest number of edges of a subgraph of $Q_n$ that contains no copy of $C_4$. Then for $n = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6$ the value of $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, C_4)$ is $1$, $3$, $9$, $24$, $56$ and $132$ respectively.
nodes.title: Four-cycle-free subgraphs of the hypercubes of dimensions one to six

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every simple graph $H$, writing $Q_n$ for the $n$-dimensional hypercube, the hypercube Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ is at most the number of edges of $Q_n$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for the hypercube Turán number

nodes.summary: Let $Q_7$ be the $7$-dimensional hypercube and $C_4$ the cycle on four vertices. The largest number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_7, C_4)$ of edges of a subgraph of $Q_7$ that contains no copy of $C_4$ is at most $308$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for four-cycle-free subgraphs of the seven-dimensional hypercube

nodes.summary: For every simple graph $H$, writing $Q_0$ for the $0$-dimensional hypercube, the hypercube Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_0, H)$ is $0$.
nodes.title: The hypercube Turán number in dimension zero

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and a simple graph $H$, let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube. The hypercube Turán number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ is the largest number of edges of a subgraph (not necessarily spanning) of $Q_n$ that contains no copy of $H$, that is, no subgraph isomorphic to $H$; it is $0$ when no such subgraph exists.
nodes.title: Hypercube Turán number

nodes.summary: Let $Q_8$ be the $8$-dimensional hypercube and $C_4$ the cycle on four vertices. The largest number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_8, C_4)$ of edges of a subgraph of $Q_8$ that contains no copy of $C_4$ is at least $682$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for four-cycle-free subgraphs of the eight-dimensional hypercube

nodes.summary: Let $Q_7$ be the $7$-dimensional hypercube and $C_4$ the cycle on four vertices. The largest number $\mathrm{ex}(Q_7, C_4)$ of edges of a subgraph of $Q_7$ that contains no copy of $C_4$ is at least $304$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for four-cycle-free subgraphs of the seven-dimensional hypercube

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$ and every simple graph $H$, let $Q_n$ be the $n$-dimensional hypercube and let $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ be the hypercube Turán number of $H$ in $Q_n$. If $S$ is a subgraph of $Q_n$ that contains no copy of $H$, then $S$ has at most $\mathrm{ex}(Q_n, H)$ edges.
nodes.title: The hypercube Turán number bounds every free subgraph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
